data.cultural_impact: Derived from the Latin word for "seas" or "bitter," Marina has long been associated with the sea and sailing. In various cultures, the sea goddesses Marina or Marenas have been revered for their protection of sailors and fishermen.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, St. Marina is honored as a martyr and healer. Legends recount that she miraculously survived several attempts to drown her and was eventually killed by a wild beast in 4th-century Rome. Her feast day is celebrated on July 17.

seo.title: Prudy: A Name of Wisdom, Modesty, and Virtue in Christianity
seo.meta_description: Prudy is a female name of English origin associated with wisdom, virtue, and simplicity in Christianity. Learn about its meaning, origin, and cultural usage.
seo.description_paragraph: The name Prudy is of English origin and has been associated with wisdom, virtue, and simplicity for centuries. Derived from the word ‘prudent’, it means wise, sensible, and discerning. In the Middle Ages, prudence was considered one of the seven heavenly virtues. Today, the name Prudy is often given to girls who are thought to possess these qualities. Its appeal lies in its association with purity, modesty, and the traditional values of the Christian faith.
